_doc: Messages in bottles. Bottles drift at these points (x, z) in stage 1; each carries a note. Notes from past lives played in the life sim are added automatically (localStorage) and float in too.
notes: We are on the roof of the Kessler building. Eleven of us. Two children. If anyone finds this — we waited.
To whoever: the kale on Greentide is better than the kale anywhere else and I will die on that hill (raft).
My son is on Highmark now. Blue wristband. He writes that the floors are dry and he cannot sleep for the quiet.
If you are Deep-Born and reading this: you are not unlucky. You are necessary. Those are different things. — H.
Tide's out. Beacon's on. Still here. — the Ferrow twins, Low Row
Don't trust the ration count on the fourth week of any month. Count your own.
Somebody hums under the Sounding. It knows three notes. Last month it knew two.
